Loss report: gha -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (events, run-name) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag (a job cannot trigger on a push and on a tag: the tag resource has no version on a branch push, so the job would never start; the job runs on push only)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: worker tags of the task (the tasks carry the worker tags ubuntu-latest; a build waits until a worker has them)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: run.path bash (the task runs bash -ec, so the image must provide bash)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.workdir: under the workspace (the relative working directory app is written as workspace/app)
